svg.aria-label: One wave of new prompts at 128 concurrent requests, replayed from the step traces. vLLM reads about 7 new prompts per step alongside decoding, so a new request gets a token about every 152 ms. SGLang reads 8 prompts per step with no decoding, so a request whose prompt was read early gets no token for 2.6 seconds.

svg.text: One wave of new prompts on NVFP4 at 128 concurrent requests, replayed from the engines' step traces 3× slower than real time.
The request followed is read early in the wave, so on SGLang it waits almost the longest (the median request waits 1.35 s).
Prompt and reply text are illustrative: the benchmark sends random tokens.
